title: Spicy Ethiopian Tibs with Peas
description: A flavorful and spicy Ethiopian dish made with tender beef, peas, and onions, served with a side of injera bread.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
4. Add the peas, spices, and salt. Stir to combine.
5. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
6. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
7. Serve hot over injera bread, garnished with chopped onion and parsley.
